```{r}
#| label: outcomesfuncsub
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false

outcomesfuncsub_inner <- function(time, event, eventname,
                                  subvar, subnames = NULL, novar = NULL, stratavar) {
  levs <- levels(sdata %>% pull(!!sym(subvar)))
  nlevs <- length(levs)

  out <- data.frame(matrix(NA, ncol = 5, nrow = nlevs))
  colnames(out) <- c("strata", "est", "lci", "uci", "p")

  if (is.null(subnames)) {
    out[, 1] <- levs
  } else {
    out[, 1] <- subnames
  }

  coxvars <- setdiff(modvars, c(subvar, novar))
  coxvars[coxvars %in% stratavar] <- paste0("strata(", coxvars[coxvars %in% stratavar], ")")

  for (i in seq_along(levs)) {
    mod <- summary(coxph(
      formula(paste0(
        "Surv(", time, ",", event, "== 'Yes') ~ case + ",
        paste(coxvars, collapse = " + "), "+ frailty(lopnrcase)"
      )),
      data = sdata %>% filter(!!sym(subvar) == levs[i])
    ))

    out[i, 2] <- mod$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    out[i, 3] <- mod$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    out[i, 4] <- mod$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    out[i, 5] <- mod$coef[1, "p"]
  }

  return(out)
}

outcomesfuncsub <- function(time, event, eventname, stratavar = NULL, xbreaks = c(.5, 1, 2)) {
  out1 <- outcomesfuncsub_inner(
    time = time,
    event = event,
    eventname = eventname,
    subvar = "scb_sex",
    stratavar = stratavar
  )
  out2 <- outcomesfuncsub_inner(
    time = time,
    event = event,
    eventname = eventname,
    subvar = "scb_age_cat",
    subnames = paste0(levels(sdata$scb_age_cat), " years"),
    stratavar = stratavar
  )
  out5 <- outcomesfuncsub_inner(
    time = time,
    event = event,
    eventname = eventname,
    subvar = "sos_med_antidiabetic",
    subnames = c("No glucose lowering", "Glucose lowering"),
    stratavar = stratavar
  )
  out6 <- outcomesfuncsub_inner(
    time = time,
    event = event,
    eventname = eventname,
    subvar = "sos_med_antikoagulantia",
    subnames = c("No lipid lowering", "Lipid lowering"),
    stratavar = stratavar
  )
  out7 <- outcomesfuncsub_inner(
    time = time,
    event = event,
    eventname = eventname,
    subvar = "rs_cat",
    subnames = paste0(levels(sdata$rs_cat), " risk factors"),
    # novar = c("sos_com_hypertension", "sos_lm_antidiabetic", "sos_com_ckd", "sos_com_copd", "sos_lm_antikoagulantia"),
    novar = c("sos_com_hypertension", "sos_med_antidiabetic", "sos_com_copd", "sos_med_antikoagulantia"),
    stratavar = stratavar
  )

  out <- bind_rows(out1, out2, out5, out6, out7)

  out <- out %>%
    mutate(
      hrprint = paste0(
        fn(est, dig = 2),
        " (", fn(lci, dig = 2),
        "-", fn(uci, dig = 2), ")"
      ),
      strata = forcats::fct_inorder(strata)
    )

  out$` ` <- paste(rep(" ", nrow(out)), collapse = " ")

  colnames(out)[1] <- "Subgroup"
  colnames(out)[6] <- "HR (95% CI)"

  tm <- forest_theme(
    core = list(bg_params = list(fill = c("#F0F0F0", "white"))),
    base_size = 14,
    refline_gp = gpar(lty = "solid"),
    ci_col = global_cols[1],
    ci_lwd = 2.5,
    arrow_length = 0.08
    # xaxis_ticks_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"),
    # arrow_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")
  ) # ,
  # Table cell padding, width 4 and heights 3
  # core = list(padding = unit(c(4, 3), "mm")))

  # Draw the forest plot with rearranged columns
  p <- forest(out[, c(1, 7, 6)],
    est = out$est,
    lower = out$lci,
    upper = out$uci,
    ci_column = 2,
    sizes = 1.25,
    # nudge_y = 0.35,
    x_trans = "log",
    arrow_lab = c("Better", "Worse"),
    xlim = c(min(xbreaks), max(xbreaks)),
    ticks_at = xbreaks,
    theme = tm
  )
  # p <- edit_plot(p, gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"))

  create_pptx(p, width = 8, height = 8, forestp = T)
  p
}
```

  eventname = outvars$name[1],

)
